basic_profile.bio: I'm a car enthusiast based in the Midwest, currently driving a 2014 Ford Focus ST. I recently got into modding and love exploring different upgrades to enhance performance and sound. I work as an IT technician by day and spend my evenings and weekends tinkering with my car or browsing car forums. I'm single and enjoy road trips and local car meets when I can. My typical online hours are in the late evening after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge about cars is mostly self-taught through forums, YouTube videos, and trial and error in my garage. Growing up, I always helped my dad with car repairs, which sparked my initial interest in automotive work. I have a basic understanding of IT systems, which is my professional background.
